summary: Community Bancorp /VT filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026 announcing its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, payable August 1, 2026 to holders of record July 15, 2026. The filing under Item 8.01 (Other Events) includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. There are no deal terms, premium, or transaction mechanics; this is a routine dividend declaration with no change to corporate structure or capital return program. As a standard dividend announcement, it does not meet special-situation criteria.
